description: Source code for command handling in a device utility module, including command creation, destruction, execution, and usage printing.

classes.name: _Command
classes.description: Internal structure representing a command with its properties and examples.

methods.name: commandCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Command object with provided parameters.

methods.name: commandDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a Command object and its components.

methods.name: commandGetName
methods.description: Returns a copy of the command's name.

methods.name: commandGetShortName
methods.description: Returns a copy of the command's short interactive name.

methods.name: commandExecute
methods.description: Executes the command if argument constraints are satisfied.

methods.name: commandAddExample
methods.description: Adds an example string to the command's list of examples.

methods.name: commandPrintUsage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the command, including examples.
